title: From Encoding to Generation: Towards Empathetic Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.27603v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Empathetic interaction involves two distinguishable capacities: representing another person's emotional state (cognitive empathy) and generating an appropriate response to that state (affective empathy). We apply this distinction to examine how emotion-related information is internally organized, selectively attended to, and carried through response generation in Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct across 10 emotion categories from the EmpatheticDialogues dataset. Layer-wise linear probing revealed a broad middle-layer region of peak emotion-category decodability, with the layer-11 L2 probe achieving 63.6% held-out accuracy against a 10% chance level and a 54.6% TF-IDF lexical baseline. During response generation, emotion-related user tokens received 1.89 times as much attention per token as other utterance tokens, concentrated across layers 10-15. Target-emotion alignment then decreased from a mean cosine similarity of 0.239 for input representations

translated_title: 从编码到生成：迈向具有共情能力的大语言模型
translated_abstract: 共情交互涉及两种可区分的能力：表征他人情绪状态（认知共情）以及针对该状态生成恰当的回应（情感共情）。我们将这一区分应用于考察 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 在 EmpatheticDialogues 数据集的 10 个情绪类别上，情绪相关信息如何在内部被组织、被选择性关注，以及如何在回应生成过程中被传递。逐层线性探测揭示了一个广泛的中层区域，该区域情绪类别解码能力达到峰值，其中第 11 层的 L2 探测器在留出集上取得了 63.6% 的准确率，而随机水平为 10%，TF-IDF 词法基线为 54.6%。在回应生成过程中，与情绪相关的用户词元获得的每词元注意力是其他话语词元的 1.89 倍，且集中在第 10-15 层。随后，目标情绪的对齐度出现下降，输入表征的平均余弦相似度为 0.239……
tldr: 该研究通过逐层线性探测与注意力分析，首次系统揭示了大语言模型从编码到生成过程中情绪信息的处理机制：情绪类别在中层（约第 11 层）最易解码，情绪相关词元在生成时获得约 1.89 倍的注意力，但情绪对齐度随生成过程逐渐衰减。
en_tdlr: This study systematically reveals how LLMs process emotional information from encoding to generation via layer-wise linear probing and attention analysis: emotion categories are most decodable in middle layers (around layer 11), emotion-related tokens receive about 1.89x more attention during generation, yet emotion alignment gradually decays throughout the generation process.
